title: Morgan Stanley lifts S&P 500’s annual target on hopes of earnings-driven rallies By Reuters

snippet:
citeturn27search0 [wordlim: 200] Published: 6 months ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; May 13 (Reuters) - Morgan Stanley raised its annual target for the benchmark S&P 500 index on Wednesday, saying U.S. stocks had enough room to rally as companies continue to post strong earnings.

The brokerage lifted its annual target for the index to 8,000 from 7,800, with an 8% upside to the index’s Tuesday close of 7,400 points.

Per-share earnings estimates for S&P 500 companies were set at $339 for 2026, a 23% jump from a year earlier, based on expectations of efficiency gains from broader AI adoption as well as improving pricing power.
